scientific_integrity: The statement follows from finite-dimensional LP norm duality, uniform strong law and a multivariate central limit theorem. Numerical primal-dual checks are supplementary and do not prove the limit. Priority relative to unindexed statistical calibration work remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ambient dimension d>=2, iid uniform points, degree-one exactness, and asymptotic rather than finite-m confidence. The unconstrained norm-optimal weights are positive on box-radius events below one. No joint high-dimensional or higher-degree conclusion.
title: Sharp chi-law for nearly uniform random spherical one-design weights
